تحتقرن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِرْنَ (taḥtaqirna) /taħ.ta.qir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# تُحْتَقَرْنَ (tuḥtaqarna) /tuħ.ta.qar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
